notes.title: Krimson Update 1
notes.notes:
Hey everyone!
I have two news today!
[h1]Steam Version received its first update!
[/h1]fixes:
[list]
[*] Fixed the achievements
[*] Made some adjustments to collision boxes in level 424 and 212
[*] The "Finish Circle X without dying" Achievements have been reworked so now you can play each level of each circle separately and when you've done them all without dying, you'll get the achievement. You can see which levels you've finished without dying in the "Player Info" in the main menu.
[*] Other minor bug fixes
[/list]
Let me know if there are any issues with this update in the [url=discord.gg/yR4xkkZ]discord server[/url]
Now to the other news
[h1]OST now available on BandCamp!
[/h1]As some of you mentioned, not everyone is comfortable with steam in regards to OST, so I published it on a more traditional music platform. [url=https://cryingpsycho.bandcamp.com/album/krimson-ost]Get it here![/url]

notes.title: Release Date Announcement!
notes.notes:
Welcome mortals and hell friends,

The hour of revelation is nigh as we prepare to descend into the rhythm hell of Krimson. Prepare thy souls! Krimson will be rhythmically bouncing into your seances on March 21st!

[url=https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=fhTFxa9g7aQ]Check out the release date announcement trailer![/url]

Thanks so much for your support and remember to channel all your rage into the musical beats.

notes.title: Krimson Next Fest Demo - Take on the challenge!
notes.notes:
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42849154/c91b0325638a604faeaa3907243437a478de1544.jpg[/img]

We're delighted to share a new demo of Krimson for Steam Next Fest, a challenging gritty rhythm platformer featuring heavy electronic metal music.

You're an unknown spawn moving through a hellish world as it shifts rhythmically to the music. One wrong move means death but the checkpoints are often, and death is very short.

Hell hath rhythm and only the ones who can dance with it can conquer it. Platforms, obstacles, hazards, objects, and rules change in synch with music, the heart of this game. This game is an interactive industrial electronic techno dubstep metal album so prepare your finest headphones for this one; your ears will thank you for it!

We hope you'll enjoy taking on World 1 in our demo!
